top_violation_types.title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver who the director stated received orientation during hire did not have documentation of the verified orientation.    This was corrected during inspection with the director and caregiver signing completion of orientation.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire Safety documentation was not available.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
